appDescription: An in-car learning app that plays short teacher-made audio lessons fitted to the remaining trip time and helps families prepare for school.

function.name: START_LESSON
function.description: Start a DAIT audio lesson that fits the remaining trip time or the requested length.

minutes.description: Lesson length in minutes when the user names one.

subject.description: School subject of the lesson when the user names one.

function.name: CONTROL_LESSON
function.description: Pause or resume the DAIT lesson that is playing now.

command.description: Whether to pause or resume the lesson.

function.name: GET_SCHOOL_PREP
function.description: Tell what the child should prepare for the next school day, with the lunch menu and subjects.
